Serialized (via the application's shared Jackson 24 * {@code ObjectMapper}) to a JSON object 25 * {@code {seq, ownerId, memberId, membershipLevel, event:'OWNER_CREATED'}} where {@code seq} is a 26 * monotonically increasing integer across creates. 27 * 28 *

The {@code memberId} field carries the owner's current primary identifier (see 29 * {@link org.springframework.samples.petclinic.model.Owner#primaryIdentifier()}): the unified 30 * {@code memberId}, so the event always names the owner by its live identity. 31 * 32 * @param seq a monotonically increasing sequence number across creates 33 * @param ownerId the new owner's id 34 * @param memberId the owner's current primary identifier 35 * @param membershipLevel the owner's effective membership level 36 */ 37 @JsonPropertyOrder({"seq", "ownerId", "memberId", "membershipLevel", "event"}) 38 public record OwnerCreatedEvent(long seq, Integer ownerId, String memberId, Integer membershipLevel) { 39 40 /** The fixed {@code event} discriminator carried by every instance. */ 41 public static final String EVENT = "OWNER_CREATED"; 42 43 /** The event discriminator, serialized as the {@code event} JSON property. */ 44 @JsonProperty("event") 45 public String event() { 46 return EVENT; 47 } 48 } 49

                <groupId>org.openapitools</groupId>
                <artifactId>openapi-generator-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <!-- RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <version>${maven.openapi-generator-plugin.version}</version>
                <!-- /RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>generate</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <inputSpec>${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/openapi.yml</inputSpec>

                            <library>spring-boot</library>

                            <modelNameSuffix>Dto</modelNameSuffix>

                            <generateModels>true</generateModels>
                            <modelPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto</modelPackage>
                            <generateApis>true</generateApis>
                            <importMappings>
                                <importMapping>Nullable=org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable</importMapping>

                                <!-- RestController implementation is provided by Petclinic developers -->
                                <interfaceOnly>true</interfaceOnly>
                                <!-- Generate API interfaces from OpenAPI tags -->
                                <useTags>true</useTags>

                                <performBeanValidation>true</performBeanValidation>

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressValidation"
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific title for the pet owner. When present it must
            be one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Used to compose the owner's
            'salutation' on the response.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: 'DR'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Flat form, kept for backward
            compatibility; prefer the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields. An owner is valid when it supplies an address in either form
            (a non-blank 'addressLine1', or this flat 'address'). On the response
            this is the composed, normalized address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when present, falling back to the flat value.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (typically street number and name). Preferred over the flat
            'address' field when present; normalized the same way (upper-cased,
            whitespace collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized the same way as
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The normalized E.164 value is stored
            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            exactly 4 digits and valid for the owner's city, whose region fixes
            the allowed range (Sydney/NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane/QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned unchanged when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. Once set it is stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional. When present it is used to derive the owner's ageBand,
            computed against the registrationDate. Stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only hint, supplied on create, declaring that this owner
            deliberately lives in the same household as an existing owner (same
            last name and postcode). A second owner in an existing household is
            otherwise rejected as a household duplicate (409); setting this flag
            bypasses that duplicate block, so the owner is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Not
            stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title and the last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the
                last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field keeps the unformatted
                E.164 value.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The unified stable owner identity assigned when the owner is
                created, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' (no separators)
                where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (or
                'UNKNOWN' when no region can be derived), FY is the two-digit
                fiscal year of the registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                telephone concatenated with the last name, and CHK is a single
                Luhn check digit over the digits of the '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'
                prefix. It carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household,
                i.e. with the same last name (compared case-insensitively with
                collapsed whitespace) and postcode. Formatted 'HH-<HEX12>' where
                HEX12 is the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                the normalized last name, a '|' separator and the postcode. It is
                deterministic, so owners with the same last name and postcode share
                it automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3A7F1C9B2E4D'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal-year number. The fiscal year starts on 1
                July and is named for the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registrationDate of 2026-08-01 yields 'FY27' and 2026-03-01
                yields 'FY26'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                A derived points score, assigned on create: starting at 0, add 2
                when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for
                a household of 3 or more members, and add 3 when the owner's tenure
                (elapsed fiscal years from registrationDate to today) is more than
                one fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                A derived numeric membership level from 1 to 4, mapped from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and
                4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region for the owner, taken from the REGION segment
                of the memberId (its leading letters before the FY segment), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no member id.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table
                (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not in the
                table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                A derived marketing segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when the owner's membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality is a known
                region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                A warning flag set when more than 80 owners have already been
                created on this owner's registration day. Assigned on create and
                returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                A warning flag set when the owner's city (compared
                case-insensitively) already holds between 40 and 49 owners when
                this owner is created, signalling the city is approaching its
                capacity limit of 50. Assigned on create and returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred channel for contacting the owner, derived from
                whether an email is present: 'EMAIL' when an email is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key through which all duplicate detection is
                expressed: the lower-case hex SHA-256 digest over
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the email
                segment is empty when no email is present). Two owners are the
                same identity only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              pattern: '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate computed against
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Present only when a birthDate is
                set.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                A flag set on create when the owner shares an existing owner's
                household (same last name and postcode) while having a different
                telephone, and was not declared a household member via
                'sharesHousehold'. A declared household member is never flagged.
                False otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates, set
                only when possibleDuplicate is true. Absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A derived flag that is true when the owner warrants a manual
                risk review, i.e. when any of these hold: the owner is a
                possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is true), the owner's
                email domain is disposable-adjacent (it shares the registrable
                base label of a known disposable domain, such as a different
                TLD or a subdomain, without being itself on the disposable
                blocklist), or the owner's city is over its soft capacity (the
                capacityWarning band, i.e. at or above the capacity-warning
                threshold). False otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. DELETE /api/owners/{id}
                sets this true and retains the record, so the owner is still
                readable; a newly created owner is false. Deleted owners are
                ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:

              description: >-

              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:

      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string

            text/plain:

      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          required: false
          description: >-
            Optional idempotency key. When a create is retried with a key that
            has already produced an owner, the originally created owner is
            returned with 200 instead of creating a duplicate.
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: >-
            The create repeated an already-seen idempotency key; the originally
            created pet owner is returned.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string

      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:

              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:

        304:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressValidation"
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific title for the pet owner. When present it must
            be one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Used to compose the owner's
            'salutation' on the response.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: 'DR'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Flat form, kept for backward
            compatibility; prefer the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields. An owner is valid when it supplies an address in either form
            (a non-blank 'addressLine1', or this flat 'address'). On the response
            this is the composed, normalized address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when present, falling back to the flat value.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (typically street number and name). Preferred over the flat
            'address' field when present; normalized the same way (upper-cased,
            whitespace collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized the same way as
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The normalized E.164 value is stored
            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            exactly 4 digits and valid for the owner's city, whose region fixes
            the allowed range (Sydney/NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane/QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned unchanged when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. Once set it is stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional. When present it is used to derive the owner's ageBand,
            computed against the registrationDate. Stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only hint, supplied on create, declaring that this owner
            deliberately lives in the same household as an existing owner (same
            last name and postcode). A second owner in an existing household is
            otherwise rejected as a household duplicate (409); setting this flag
            bypasses that duplicate block, so the owner is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Not
            stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, composed as the title and the last name
                separated by a single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the
                last name when no title is given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field keeps the unformatted
                E.164 value.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal-year number. The fiscal year starts on 1
                July and is named for the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registrationDate of 2026-08-01 yields 'FY27' and 2026-03-01
                yields 'FY26'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                A derived points score, assigned on create: starting at 0, add 2
                when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for
                a household of 3 or more members, and add 3 when the owner's tenure
                (elapsed fiscal years from registrationDate to today) is more than
                one fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                A derived numeric membership level from 1 to 4, mapped from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and
                4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region for the owner, taken from the REGION segment
                of the memberId (its leading letters before the FY segment), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no member id.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table
                (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not in the
                table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                A derived marketing segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when the owner's membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality is a known
                region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                A warning flag set when more than 80 owners have already been
                created on this owner's registration day. Assigned on create and
                returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                A warning flag set when the owner's city (compared
                case-insensitively) already holds between 40 and 49 owners when
                this owner is created, signalling the city is approaching its
                capacity limit of 50. Assigned on create and returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred channel for contacting the owner, derived from
                whether an email is present: 'EMAIL' when an email is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key through which all duplicate detection is
                expressed: the lower-case hex SHA-256 digest over
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the email
                segment is empty when no email is present). Two owners are the
                same identity only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              pattern: '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
              example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate computed against
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Present only when a birthDate is
                set.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                A flag set on create when the owner shares an existing owner's
                household (same last name and postcode) while having a different
                telephone, and was not declared a household member via
                'sharesHousehold'. A declared household member is never flagged.
                False otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates, set
                only when possibleDuplicate is true. Absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                A derived flag that is true when the owner warrants a manual
                risk review, i.e. when any of these hold: the owner is a
                possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is true), the owner's
                email domain is disposable-adjacent (it shares the registrable
                base label of a known disposable domain, such as a different
                TLD or a subdomain, without being itself on the disposable
                blocklist), or the owner's city is over its soft capacity (the
                capacityWarning band, i.e. at or above the capacity-warning
                threshold). False otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. DELETE /api/owners/{id}
                sets this true and retains the record, so the owner is still
                readable; a newly created owner is false. Deleted owners are
                ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>' using the owner's own id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

        totalElements:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressValidation"
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific title for the pet owner. When present it must
            be one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Used to compose the owner's
            'salutation' on the response.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: 'DR'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Flat form, kept for backward
            compatibility; prefer the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields. An owner is valid when it supplies an address in either form
            (a non-blank 'addressLine1', or this flat 'address'). On the response
            this is the composed, normalized address: the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when present, falling back to the flat value.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (typically street number and name). Preferred over the flat
            'address' field when present; normalized the same way (upper-cased,
            whitespace collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). Normalized the same way as
            'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must
            have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The normalized E.164 value is stored
            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            exactly 4 digits and valid for the owner's city, whose region fixes
            the allowed range (Sydney/NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane/QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned unchanged when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. Once set it is stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional. When present it is used to derive the owner's ageBand,
            computed against the registrationDate. Stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only hint, supplied on create, declaring that this owner
            deliberately lives in the same household as an existing owner (same
            last name and postcode). A second owner in an existing household is
            otherwise rejected as a household duplicate (409); setting this flag
            bypasses that duplicate block, so the owner is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Not
            stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false

        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone

              description: >-

              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal-year number. The fiscal year starts on 1
                July and is named for the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registrationDate of 2026-08-01 yields 'FY27' and 2026-03-01
                yields 'FY26'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                A derived points score, assigned on create: starting at 0, add 2
                when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for
                a household of 3 or more members, and add 3 when the owner's tenure
                (elapsed fiscal years from registrationDate to today) is more than
                one fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                A derived numeric membership level from 1 to 4, mapped from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5 and
                4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region for the owner, taken from the REGION segment
                of the memberId (its leading letters before the FY segment), or
                'UNKNOWN' when the owner has no member id.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table
                (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not in the
                table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                A derived marketing segment formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when the owner's membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise
                'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality is a known
                region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or
                'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-

                created on this owner's registration day. Assigned on create and
                returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                A warning flag set when the owner's city (compared
                case-insensitively) already holds between 40 and 49 owners when
                this owner is created, signalling the city is approaching its
                capacity limit of 50. Assigned on create and returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:

              readOnly: true
            ageBand:

              description: >-

              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                A flag set on create when the owner shares an existing owner's
                household (same last name and postcode) while having a different
                telephone, and was not declared a household member via

              readOnly: true

                TLD or a subdomain, without being itself on the disposable
                blocklist), or the owner's city is over its soft capacity (the
                capacityWarning band, i.e. at or above the capacity-warning

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true

              description: >-

              type: array

input.old_string:

input.new_string:
OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's stable identifiers, derived with the version-2 algorithm
        that mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag so every identifier differs from
        the value version 1 would have produced. The 'V2' tag appears only
        inside these identifiers, never in the user-facing locality, timezone or
        owner segment.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The unified stable owner identity assigned when the owner is
            created, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' (no separators) where
            REGION is the version-2 region code derived from the postcode (the
            plain region code with the 'V2' tag mixed in, or 'UNKNOWNV2' when no
            region can be derived), FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the
            registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of
            SHA-256 over the 'V2' tag, the normalized telephone and the last
            name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit over the digits of the
            '<REGION><FY><HASH8>' prefix. It carries no sequence number.
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV2271A2B3C4D5'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The single derived key through which all duplicate detection is
            expressed: the lower-case hex SHA-256 digest over
            'V2|normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the email
            segment is empty when no email is present). Two owners are the same
            identity only when their whole identity keys are equal.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
          example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable identifier shared by all owners in the same household, i.e.
            with the same last name (compared case-insensitively with collapsed
            whitespace) and postcode. Formatted 'HH-<HEX12>' where HEX12 is the
            first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the 'V2' tag, the
            normalized last name and the postcode. It is deterministic, so owners
            with the same last name and postcode share it automatically.
          type: string
          example: 'HH-3A7F1C9B2E4D'
          readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'

OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's stable identifiers, derived with the version-2 algorithm
        that mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag so every identifier differs from
        the value version 1 would have produced. The 'V2' tag appears only
        inside these identifiers, never in the user-facing locality, timezone or
        owner segment.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The unified stable owner identity assigned when the owner is
            created, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' (no separators) where
            REGION is the version-2 region code derived from the postcode (the
            plain region code with the 'V2' tag mixed in, or 'UNKNOWNV2' when no
            region can be derived), FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the
            registrationDate, HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of
            SHA-256 over the 'V2' tag, the normalized telephone and the last
            name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit over the digits of the
            '<REGION><FY><HASH8>' prefix. It carries no sequence number.
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV2271A2B3C4D5'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The single derived key through which all duplicate detection is
            expressed: the lower-case hex SHA-256 digest over
            'V2|normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)' (the email
            segment is empty when no email is present). Two owners are the same
            identity only when their whole identity keys are equal.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
          example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:

            first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the 'V2' tag, the
            normalized last name and the postcode. It is deterministic, so owners
            with the same last name and postcode share it automatically.
          type: string
          example: 'HH-3A7F1C9B2E4D'
          readOnly: true

      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      x-class-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PostcodeValidation @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.AddressValidation"
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific title for the pet owner. When present it must
            be one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Used to compose the owner's
            'salutation' on the response.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: 'DR'
        address:
          title: Address

          title: Status

          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true

          title: Detail
